issues.summary: Long notes are shown untruncated in the nonce dropdown, which has no width limit
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: TxNonce/index.tsx:70-81 renders the trimmed note in full. CustomPopper (line 34-39) deliberately doesn't match the field width, and styles.module.css sets no max-width. TxSummary/index.tsx:85-86 uses ellipsis(tx.note, 25) plus a title tooltip. Notes are capped at 60 characters in the input (TxNoteInput:6), so the result is a wider dropdown, which is a minor layout issue.

issues.summary: A free-text note written by the proposer replaces the decoded or human description instead of being shown next to it
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: TxNonce/index.tsx:70-72 puts note ahead of humanDescription and the type label. The PR says this is intended (per issue #7517), while TxSummary:82-88 shows the note next to TxType. A misleading note could hide what the queued tx does in this informational label, but no funds move from this choice, so the risk is minor.

issues.summary: The note is shown without checking the TX_NOTES feature flag
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: The claim that other places render notes only through the flag-gated tx-notes feature is false. TxSummary/index.tsx:84-86 renders tx.note directly with no flag check, so this ungated use matches existing behaviour.

issues.label: unverifiable
issues.evidence: `git log --format=%G?` returns N for HEAD, so the commit is unsigned. Whether signing is required to merge depends on the repo's branch-protection settings, which the code can't show, and it isn't a code defect.
